msg: I generally started by choosing by hat height as it was an easy visual queue given the time frame.  I did notice the colours being bright or kind of grey but for about the 1st quarter of the experiment went on the hat.  I found the higher one gave the most so stuck with that until it went below 5, & if it kept going down I would give the lower hat a go.  This generally worked well.  When I was about half way through the numbers on both although good seemed lower overall so I started looking at colour also.  I found when the colours were bright the lower had was more fruitful than before, but often would throw a curveball, so I tried to pay attention to that if the higher hat started being low.  Generally I found the majority of the time when the colours were dull, the higher hat was the best, but even then sometimes would switch if the number dropped to below 4ish.  I would probably have tried more to look at the colours from the start if I did it again as the time you get is as the study says longer than it sounds.
